title: Fletcher Henderson calls; leaving Honey Potter
summary: Henderson phones to offer Scott a place in his band; Cecil Smith urges him to go and shoves him onto the train past an angry Honey Potter.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: So finally, after playing around here, there and everywhere, I got a call one night. And a fellow said -- asked me who I was and I told him, and he said he was Fletcher Henderson. Well, I had heard something -- it wasn't many musicians in New York that -- anyone new comes to town, it just circulates very fast and the next day everybody knew there was a new guy in town.
And I had heard that a guy named Fletcher Henderson had -- but I didn't know nothing about him and all like that.
And he said he'd heard about me and he'd like for me to join his band.

Well, this Cecil Smith, I was still working with him, the same fellow. We were playing out at Honey Potter's, and I told him that I was working nights. And he said, that's all right, I'll see you the next day. So when I went out -- we went out there, I got Cecil to (unintelligible). I said, Cecil, I got to break the news to Honey Potter. Fletcher Henderson called me up and said he wanted me to join his band. Cecil said, that's great, Scotty, he says, but don't tell Honey now. Wait til you get through.

Well, when I went on that job that night, I played -- they told me I played like I never played before. I was so happy, in a way. And Cecil told me, he says, now, this is your big chance, Scottie, so you might as well take it. So after he got through, we worked on the North Side and we had to come to Hempstead to catch the 1:30 train. That was the only train coming into Penn Station at that time, before 7:00 in the morning.

So we got to the station. Honey drove us there and we went upstairs. Then I called Honey aside and told him. He was furious. He said, he'd knock every tooth out of my mouth before he'd let me go away. And the train came in to Dalton, and I was trying to plead with him. Cecil took me and pushed me in the train and the door closed. And he pushed me and he
kind of did like that to me. I said, you hurt me, Cecil, you hurt me. He says, you can't fight Honey. Honey is big and strong. Honey didn't want to let me go.

Well, they liked me over on the Island and I liked the different people. We played so many places, all over, all around. Even way out near Southampton and all that way. And, well, I joined Fletcher. Cecil told me he had a chance, Fletcher had talked to him, but he didn't want to take it. After all, he was older than me, much older. But he'd just came out of the Army and all like that, but that was my big chance.
